title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Regarding qiblah direction while offering namaz 1754 views Q. Dear Sheikh! Can we pray Ishraq Salah at home? 6401 views Q. Sometimes, in local flight travel or international travel, the plane will be small and there would not be enough place to offer Salah standing. In such a situation, can we offer Salah by sitting on our seat itself ? 2400 views Q. What is the correct way of making neeyat for qaza namaz.i make neeyat like this -neeyat karta hoon main 2 rakaat namaz fard kaza pehli fajir waste allah tala ke muh mera taraf qabah sherif. Is it correct? 21519 views Q. Standing Alone In Row 3004 views Q. Assalamu alaikum, We have few elderly and disabled people and also young men using chairs to pray as they cannot perform sajda. Few brothers are saying that there in no mention of praying using chairs in any hadiths and their prayers are not valid. Could you please advice. Jazakamullah khairun 2723 views Q. Farz Namaaz Loud Recitation for praying alone at home. 5047 views Q. Leftover Rakat of fard prayer 2609 views Q. I work in Saudi Arabia and go back home after every one year. I belong to Nainital district of U.P. (Now Uttarakhand) which is very near to Bareilly and the Barelwi Maslak is rampant in that area. "Mazar parasti" and Urs, etc., are the foremost part of their Islam and Aqeeda. In my village there are only two mosques and the Imams leading the prayers are staunch Barelwi. I had a discussion with one of these Imams of our moque, he has the belief that to ask for help (Mannat) with the dead (Mazar) is as good as praying God. Since then, I stopped praying with him. I offer all my five prayers in my home during my vacation of one month or so. Secondly, my wife is very punctual in prayers and other Shariah matters. She also joins my prayers which I lead in my house. Please enlighten me on;(1)if, under the circumstances explained above, my prayers in my home are correct, (2) prayers led by me and joined by my wife are correct. or I should go the mosque and pray behing the same Imam as explained above. I shall highly appreciate your immediate reply on the above e-mail address. Best regards 2929 views Q. Performing Witr Namaz in mecca or medina during ramdan 5938 views Q. I wanted to know whether it is necessary to do Fajr salah with jamah, to do imamah or be imam for any prayer during that day? 1804 views Q. Salaam If an imaam makes mistakes such as 'sits down in the fourth rakaat' when he should stand who is corrected by the people behind him, who then say subhanallah and this occurs with the imaam 2/3 times a week, 1/ should the imaam be replaced? 2/ would the salaat have to be performed again? 1742 views Q. If one has the problem of passing wind frequently due to gastric disease - even after performing wudhu and if one has a problem of incontinence 3620 views Q. i want to ask a question is jamat salat of two persons allowed? 8494 views Q. Is it allowed to pray fardh salah with jamah at home with my mother as my only muqtadi and I make her stand behind me not next to me? 2216 views
answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 170715 Country: India Title: Can we offer Qaza-e-Umari of witr salah? Question: Can we offer Qaza-e-Umari of witr salah? Answer ID: 170715 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 825/732/SD=09/1440) If you have missed witr salah then you will have to make its qaza as well and you must offer them. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
